user_query: I am planning a family vacation to a scenic location. Can you suggest some eco-friendly activities and calculate the carbon footprint of our transportation using public transit? Also, provide me with healthcare mailing lists in the area for potential medical services.

TaskList.description: Research and list eco-friendly activities available in the chosen scenic location.
Calculate the carbon footprint of the transportation using public transit based on distance and mode of transport.
Compile a mailing list of healthcare services available in the area.
